document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.s-filter button');
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.s-notes > li');
  var shown = document.querySelector('.s-shown');
  buttons.forEach(function (button) {
    button.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var topic = button.dataset.topic;
      var count = 0;
      buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b === button ? 'true' : 'false'); });
      rows.forEach(function (row) {
        var match = topic === 'All' || row.dataset.topics.split('|').indexOf(topic) !== -1;
        row.hidden = !match;
        if (match) count++;
      });
      shown.textContent = count + ' shown';
    });
  });
});
</script>
